thread:
incident-bot: Pager — P1: High 429 rate detected for Equinox (tenant eqx-prod) in VPC eu-west-3 dedicated pool. 92% 429s over last 5m. Auto-escalation triggered. Incident channel: #incidents. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2051234567

alice-m: I’m on call, picking this up. @kevin-ops can you confirm pool health + any config changes?

kevin-ops: looking now. querying metrics...
```
obs.query('pool:eqx-prod', window='5m').groupby('status').count()
```
seeing huge spike in quota_exceeded errors from a small set of client IPs. burst of ~3x normal qps starting 10m ago. no recent deploys to pool.

maria-sre: tagging in for isolation options. we can either route eqx traffic to an isolated burst pool or apply a short-lived quota override. routing is fastest.

jordan-eng: do we know if this is valid user traffic or a bot loop? any logs with repeated request patterns?

kevin-ops: sampling logs — looks like many calls with identical prompt templates and high token counts, same client-id header repeated. could be a rogue batch job.

emma-csm: FYI Equinox CS just pinged us — they rolled a marketing email around 08:10 UTC, and said they expected a bump but didn’t request emergency lift. they’re asking for temporary relief now.

sales-liz: we have a note about a lift request earlier but it never got formal approval. if we grant emergency capacity it needs a post-facto billing change. i can get verbal OK from their VP but need finance ticket.

alice-m: plan proposal: (1) route eqx -> eqx-burst (isolated pool) to stop cross-tenant impact, (2) apply 60m temporary quota override for eqx, (3) enable per-client throttles and tracing to identify offending job. can we proceed?

kevin-ops: i’ll perform the route change now. applying in 30s.
```
# control plane call
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/route -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"eqx","to_pool":"eqx-burst","mode":"isolate"}'
```

deploy-bot: Route change initiated: request_id=rc-9f3b. Will post status when complete.

kevin-ops: route change succeeded (request_id=rc-9f3b). starting quota override after quick sanity check.

kevin-ops: applying quota override:
```
redwood quota override --tenant eqx --tokens-per-minute 500000 --expires-in 60m --reason "marketing spike - emergency" --approve-by oncall
```
deploy-bot: Quota override accepted and active until 60m from now. ticket=QO-4873.

maria-sre: monitoring metrics post-change — 5m after isolation + override: 429_rate dropped from 92% -> 4%. p50 latency moved 95ms -> 118ms. Looks stable.
```
pre: 429_rate=92%, p50=95ms
post: 429_rate=4%, p50=118ms
```

emma-csm: I have verbal approval from Equinox VP to proceed for 1 hour. I’ll open a follow-up formal change and coordinate billing with @sales-liz.

sales-liz: opening billing ticket and order amendment. will add finance + legal. ticket: BT-9124.

jordan-eng: we should also add a per-client soft throttle and enable request-level tracing to catch the rogue job. propose: per-ip 100r/s + trace sampling 100% for eqx for next 30m. any objections?

alice-m: no objections. @kevin-ops can you apply the policy?

kevin-ops: applied per-ip throttle and trace sampling.
```
redwood policy add --tenant eqx --policy 'per_ip:100r/s' --trace-sample 1.0
```

ryan-obs: confirmed traces show a handful of client-ids with repetitive high-token calls. cs is reaching out to them. good candidate for blocking if they don’t respond.

maria-sre: handing off monitoring to morning oncall at 2051234800. Mitigation successful; P1 still open until billing/order updated and postmortem scheduled. marking as mitigated for cross-tenant impact. :white_check_mark:

alice-m: thanks team — great quick work. please add any follow-ups to the incident ticket and keep CS looped. i’m leaving the channel (oncall handoff done).
